length_statistics.scope: Full Introduction excluding heading and author footnote; include four desideratum labels and content. Terminal navigation recorded separately.
length_statistics.method: PDF text extracted locally with PyMuPDF, Unicode NFKC and line-break hyphen normalization; source sentence boundaries manually checked against pp.1–2 images. Remove bracketed numbered citation markers, contribution/list letter labels and roman enumeration labels. Count whitespace-separated tokens containing an ASCII letter or digit; internal hyphenated/slash forms count as one. Standalone multiplication symbol is not a token; its two numbers count separately. Requirements include their one-word labels. Source spelling retained for counting; no source text shipped.
length_statistics.coordinate_note: C3.aggregate_sentence is a local aggregate count, not a registered original-map coordinate. C3.S1a/b/c are analytical parts of that one sentence and must not be added as extra sentences.
length_statistics.interpretation_limit: Descriptive measurements for this fixed version, not word targets, genre norms or quality scores.

source_internal_cautions: C3.S1a example in Table III changes ACAC and distortion while MR remains 100%; cannot rewrite as increased success rate.
C2 indicator-proposal wording does not establish all 15 metrics as wholly novel; definitions cite existing quantities.
Table IX completely-random JSMA accuracy is 6%, inconsistent with the p.13 blanket above-20% lower-tail description.
Cross-attack averages do not by themselves establish worst-case security or a formal lower bound.
